narrative: Escalation in the Strait of Hormuz over mine strikes on oil tankers dominates weekend risk, setting up an energy bid and safe-haven USD support for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1143; the Fed-ECB +148bp OIS carry advantage leaves downside pressure intact heading into the open. Meanwhile, USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4128, where divergent employment prints and elevated crude prices point to choppy crosscurrents ahead of Monday's Eurogroup meeting.
